module: Position smoothing filter: three temporal springs (newTemporalSpring) on x, y, z of data.res.pos. Hidden. Returns a constructor.
notes: The extracted page says init(damp, pos) but the code defines init(spring, damp, pos). Default values: spring 30, damp 10.

init.desc: Creates the springs; if pos is given, initializes them to that position.

update.desc: Smooths data.res.pos axis by axis with data.dt.
